Watcom field-by-field struct copy (3 consecutive `dst.field = src.field;` lines). Replace with `dst = src;` or `memcpy(&dst, &src, sizeof(...));` in a .keep — but only once the run (together with any sibling runs for the same dst/src pair) covers every byte of the struct. Collapsing a run that leaves a gap WIDENS the copy and changes behaviour; see `partial_struct_copy` (§31) for that case.

Inlined fast sqrt bit-trick (bias `_DAT_01caf5b4`). Ghidra's numeric `(int)` cast is wrong; the asm reinterprets the float's bit pattern. Bias `_DAT_01caf5b4` is not a known magic - this may be a sibling-program variant. Confirm against the .asm (SAR/ADD on the float's bits), then express it via a bit-cast helper in a .keep; no named helper is guaranteed to exist in this program.
